implementation_choices: 1. 'quantili ricalcolati sul disegno' (note §4, §6): 5-95 % numpy-linear quantiles of the cell activity replicated on the records of the T3 design itself (phase A used T5 records, which Q4 does not build); a different set from T5. Reported as columns target_qd_* with every target-dependent product, and the quantiles A_lo_design, A_hi_design.
2. covariance check (note §5): min eigenvalue >= -1e-10 * max eigenvalue, cached per (cell CR, cell hemisphere, scenario, cross-zero variant); the key keeps the order of the cells.
3. ratios h/h_H use H with model (a), the same sigma_int and the same noise row; H has sigma_m,HMI = 0 and does not depend on the realisation, the threshold or the MDI sensitivity.

4. A_main sensitivity (MDI alone only): a declared numeric scenario. target_* keep the E0 SILSO quantiles (units differ from SILSO: not the same activity range nor the same physical slope; no direct physical comparison of the betas), target_qd_* report the design's own quantiles; not used by the criteria.

5. flux donors: a target group may receive itself as donor when it is a successful L1 unit (L-NN and no-latitude sensitivity); donors are reused with replacement. This is not an independent verification of that group's flux.
6. domains: MF excludes the 1998 gap but not the missing synoptic maps; MS also excludes N ambiguous (as the note); MS/MF population differences are not compensated by choosing other groups.

7. one-at-a-time sensitivities are also computed for combinations the note does not require (for example MS alone with flux_nolat): a superset of §6, same rule, labelled; no new criterion and no crossing of sensitivities.
null target: a zero ramp makes the ratios to the target (se_over_target, m_prod_over_target) not defined (NaN, flag target_null_*); SE, h and recognition are kept; no epsilon is added.
not computable designs: failures are expanded on the expected grid of configurations, so that SUMMARY has every key with n_ok and n_fail; criteria do not classify when a used realisation failed.
